ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the vertical axis is labeled Pressure (torr), and the horizontal axis is Time. The pressure-time curve starts at about 760 torr, rises with time, and then gradually becomes flat, reaching an equilibrium plateau near about 886 torr. Reasoning: The problem states that the container is rigid, so the volume is unchanged; the temperature remains constant, so temperature change is also not the reason for the pressure increase. The reaction is N2O4(g) ⇌ 2 NO2(g); each 1 N2O4 gas molecule that decomposes will produce 2 NO2 gas molecules, so the total number of gas particles increases as decomposition proceeds. Under constant-temperature, constant-volume conditions, an increase in the number of gas particles will make the pressure increase, because the number of particles colliding with the container wall per unit time increases.

raw_record.question_text: A pure sample of $N_2O_4(g)$ is placed into a rigid, evacuated, 0.500 L container. The initial pressure of the $N_2O_4(g)$ is 760 atm. The temperature is held constant until the $N_2O_4(g)$ reaches equilibrium with its decomposition products. The figure below shows how the pressure of the system changes while reaching equilibrium. Why does the pressure rise in this experiment?
raw_record.standard_answer: The number of particles striking the container walls per unit time increases.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the pressure-time curve starts near 760 torr and increases to a higher equilibrium plateau near 886 torr. From the text, note that the container is rigid and the temperature is constant, so V and T do not cause the pressure change. Write the decomposition as N2O4(g) ⇌ 2 NO2(g): each N2O4 molecule that decomposes produces two gas molecules. Therefore the total number of gas particles increases as equilibrium is approached. At constant T and V, increased particle number raises pressure, meaning more particles strike the container walls per unit time.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中纵轴标为 Pressure (torr)，横轴为 Time。压力-时间曲线从约 760 torr 开始，随时间上升，然后逐渐变平，达到约 886 torr 附近的平衡平台。推理：题目说明容器是刚性的，所以体积不变；温度保持恒定，所以温度变化也不是压力升高的原因。反应为 N2O4(g) ⇌ 2 NO2(g)，每 1 个 N2O4 气体分子分解会生成 2 个 NO2 气体分子，因此气体粒子总数随分解进行而增加。在恒温恒容条件下，气体粒子数增加会使压力升高，因为单位时间内撞击容器壁的粒子数增加。
